title: Changelog - August 2017
content:
## Changelog - August 2017


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093667

New Features:

- We added functionality to change the language of the Google Map Feature and the Google Recaptcha through Admin settings. To change the language of those modules navigate to the Admin are of your site and then Settings >> General Settings >> Configuration tab.  Here you will find a dropdown to select your chosen language.  Currently this setting will only impact the Google Maps, Google ReCaptchas, and Event Calendar language settings.  We plan on adding additional language functionality around this setting in future updates.

- We added Prev and Next meta data for a better SEO performance on paginated Search Results pages.

- The following sections in the Profile Pages are now based on text labels: Member Profile Badge section, location address section, website and social media link sections.

- We added a new Design Setting that will adapt the hero image of the homepage to mobile devices. To use this setting navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings and on the homepage search setting next to the Homepage Image you will find this new setting.

- We added a new Banner Ad into our Manage Banner Advertisements Module called the Below Header Banner Ad.  When enabled, this will show a new Banner Ad just below the Header of the Site. To modify this new feature, navigate to the Site Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Click on Banner Ad Design.

- The Promo Code Add-On is now based on Text Labels.

- We recently released an update to the Finance >> Transaction History page in the Admin.  This update includes additional functionality including the ability to cancel invoices that are set to be charged a future date, enhanced search capabilities, new reports, and more.

- We released the Recurring Events Add-On. For more information about Add-Ons please click here .

- The Sidebar Modules Search Widgets are now based on text labels.

Enhancements / Fixes:

- We made an update to improve the functionality of the Advanced Setting years_field_start_year. It is now working as expected.

- We updated the link of the Show Widget features when an Admin visits a site.

- We fixed an issue that was affecting the load speed of the pages when the Events Calendar widget has been activated.

- The Admin Email Signature is now working as it should.

- We updated the Email Templates module in order to fix the Preview button when you are editing an Email Template.

- We created a new Advanced Setting named max_text_editor_size in order to increase the max size (MB) that can be uploaded via Froala Editor, the default value is 10 (10 MB).

- Bug fixes to the Leads Module, Reviews Module, Google Location System, Add-on Manager System, and Member System.

- In all, more than 25 bugs were fixed throughout the software.
